description: A landscape scene looking across dark swamp water toward a long, low white building half hidden in dense jungle. The building has a flat roof and small red-lit windows, and sits in the middle distance surrounded by thick green foliage dotted with blue and violet leaves. The picture is framed by gnarled brown tree trunks: a huge twisted trunk on the right with a dark round knothole, smaller trunks on the left, and tangled roots reaching into the water along the bottom. The foreground is a deep blue pool scattered with tiny white sparkles and clumps of reeds. A thin strip of grey sky shows at the top behind leafy branches. The mood is humid, still and secretive, with faint yellow light at the building's base. Only the water and reeds move. Frame 1: glints sparkle across the pool and reeds. Frame 2: the glints and ripples shift to new places. Frame 3: the sparkles shift again and are held a little longer. The loop reads as a slow, gentle shimmer of light on the swamp water.
title: White house in a swamp jungle
